mapper.sql: C.CNTN_SN, C.CNTN_TYPE_CD, CASE C.CNTN_TYPE_CD WHEN 'INFO' THEN '정보안내' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '애니메이션 영상' WHEN 'SELECT' THEN '선택형 활동' WHEN 'DATA' THEN '데이터 입력' WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN '사진 업로드' WHEN 'SENTENCE' THEN '문장완성형' ELSE C.CNTN_TYPE_CD END AS CNTN_TYPE_NM, C.CARD_CLSF_CD, CASE C.CARD_CLSF_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션카드' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '탐구카드' WHEN 'EXPERIENCE' THEN '체험카드' WHEN 'DESIGN' THEN '설계활동' WHEN 'MAKER' THEN '메이커활동' ELSE C.CARD_CLSF_CD END AS CARD_CLSF_NM, C.CNTN_TTL, C.CNTN_CN, C.PRVD_TYPE_CD, CASE C.PRVD_TYPE_CD WHEN 'IMAGE' THEN '이미지' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '동영상' ELSE C.PRVD_TYPE_CD END AS PRVD_TYPE_NM, C.IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID, C.VIDEO_URL_ADDR, C.VIDEO_THMB_ATCH_FILE_ID, C.VIDEO_TTL, C.USE_YN, C.REG_DT, C.RGTR, C.MDFCN_DT, C.MDTR, C.DEL_DT, C.DELTR
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM EDU_CNTN_MST C WHERE C.CNTN_SN = #{cntnSn} AND C.DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_CNTN_MST ( CNTN_TYPE_CD, CARD_CLSF_CD, CNTN_TTL, CNTN_CN, PRVD_TYPE_CD, IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID, VIDEO_URL_ADDR, VIDEO_THMB_ATCH_FILE_ID, VIDEO_TTL, USE_YN, RGTR, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{cntnTypeCd}, #{cardClsfCd}, #{cntnTtl}, #{cntnCn}, #{prvdTypeCd}, #{imgAtchFileId}, #{videoUrlAddr}, #{videoThmbAtchFileId}, #{videoTtl}, #{useYn}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_CNTN_MST SET CNTN_TYPE_CD = #{cntnTypeCd}, CARD_CLSF_CD = #{cardClsfCd}, CNTN_TTL = #{cntnTtl}, CNTN_CN = #{cntnCn}, PRVD_TYPE_CD = #{prvdTypeCd}, IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID = #{imgAtchFileId}, VIDEO_URL_ADDR = #{videoUrlAddr}, VIDEO_THMB_ATCH_FILE_ID = #{videoThmbAtchFileId}, VIDEO_TTL = #{videoTtl}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, MDTR = #{mdtr}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE CNTN_SN = #{cntnSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
UPDATE EDU_CNTN_MST SET DEL_DT = NOW(), DELTR = 'admin' WHERE CNTN_SN = #{cntnSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT Q.CNTN_QSTN_SN, Q.CNTN_SN, Q.QSTN_TYPE_CD, CASE Q.QSTN_TYPE_CD WHEN 'SELECT' THEN '선택형 활동' WHEN 'DATA' THEN '데이터 입력' WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN '사진 업로드' WHEN 'SENTENCE' THEN '문장완성형' ELSE Q.QSTN_TYPE_CD END AS QSTN_TYPE_NM, Q.QSTN_NM, Q.QSTN_IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID, Q.OPTN_CN, Q.SORT_SEQ, Q.REG_DT, Q.RGTR, Q.MDFCN_DT, Q.MDTR FROM EDU_CNTN_QSTN Q WHERE Q.CNTN_SN = #{cntnSn} ORDER BY Q.SORT_SEQ ASC, Q.CNTN_QSTN_SN ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_CNTN_QSTN ( CNTN_SN, QSTN_TYPE_CD, QSTN_NM, QSTN_IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID, OPTN_CN, SORT_SEQ, RGTR, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{cntnSn}, #{qstnTypeCd}, #{qstnNm}, #{qstnImgAtchFileId}, #{optnCn}, #{sortSeq}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
